assumptions.statement: The project involves making architectural decisions that require documentation.
assumptions.quote: We need to record the architectural decisions made on this project.

assumptions.statement: The team is familiar with or willing to adopt the ADR methodology described by Michael Nygard.
assumptions.quote: We will use Architecture Decision Records, as described by Michael Nygard in [documenting architecture decisions](http://thinkrelevance.com/blog/2011/11/15/documenting-architecture-decisions)
